# Elected roles and votes (Shaman, Guide, Catapult master)

## In short
- A town can elect three roles: the **Shaman** (`shaman`), the **Guide to the World Beyond** (`guide`) and the **Catapult master** (`cata`) [1] [2] [3].
- An election for a role opens only once its construction is complete:
  - Guide: Observation platform (`item_scope_#00`).
  - Shaman: Soul Purifying Source (`item_soul_blue_static_#00`).
  - Catapult master: Catapult (`item_courroie_#00`).
  [4] [5]
- Votes are counted during the nightly processing. The citizen with the most votes wins. If you don't vote, your vote goes to a random candidate. If nobody votes at all, any living citizen can win [6].
- A role stays with its holder until that holder dies or is banished. Only then can a new election open [5] [7].

## How it works

### When an election is open (`TownHandler::is_vote_needed`)
A vote is needed only if **all** of these are true [5]:
1. The town is not in chaos.
2. The town is no longer open, unless it was force-started.
3. The role exists and is votable.
4. The role is enabled in this town. That means its construction is complete, because `getBuilding` returns only completed buildings by default [4] [5].
5. The role is not listed in the town setting `DisabledRoles`.
6. The role has no living holder.

**When a holder has died**, the code calculates an adjusted death day (DoD) [5]:
- If the holder died in the nightly attack: DoD = day of death − 1.
- If the holder died any other way: DoD = day of death.
- No vote is held while DoD ≥ town day − limit. The limit is 0 on normal pages and 1 during the nightly processing.

The code comment describes the result as: re-election "next day" after a death in the attack, and "one penalty day" for other deaths [5].

### How to vote
- **Town page.** The vote page (`citizens_vote`) works only outside chaos and while a vote is needed. It shows the vote you have already cast [8].
- **Rules for submitting a vote** [8]:
  - The target must be a living citizen of the same town, and not yourself.
  - The town must not be in chaos.
  - The vote must be needed.
  - Voting also removes your `special_vote_<role>` action.
- **From the World Beyond.** Every citizen gets one `special_vote_<role>` action per votable role when they join the town [9]. These actions are custom item actions 5001, 5002 and 5003 (shaman, guide, cata). They record a vote only if all of these hold, and otherwise silently do nothing [10]:
  - the target is alive;
  - you have not already voted for that role;
  - the vote is needed.
- The action requirement `RoleVote` hides these actions when no vote is needed or when you have already voted [11].

### Counting the votes (`NightlyHandler::stage3_roles`, nightly)
Roles are processed one after another. A role is skipped if the town is in chaos or if `is_vote_needed(..., duringNightly=true)` is false [6].

1. **Candidates.** A citizen is a candidate if all of these hold:
   - alive;
   - not banished, when the role does not allow banished (shunned) citizens;
   - not already elected this night (that check applies only up to day 2);
   - has at least 1 vote recorded for the role.

   **If no candidate has any vote**, every living citizen becomes a candidate with 0 votes (excluding banished ones when the role forbids them).
2. **Missing or invalid votes.** This applies to each living citizen who did not vote, or whose target is dead, banished (for a role that forbids it) or already elected this night. That citizen's vote is added (+1) to a random candidate from the candidate list. Dead citizens cast no replacement vote [6].
3. **Winner.** The candidate with the most votes wins. The comparison uses `<=`, so in a tie the last tied candidate in iteration order wins [6].
4. **Effect.** The winner gets the role through `CitizenHandler::addRole`.
   - Up to **day 2**, a winner cannot also win a later role in the same night [6].
5. **Gazette.** A council entry is written in one of these variants [6]:
   - "single": only 1 living citizen;
   - "few": fewer than 10 living citizens;
   - "next": a previous holder existed;
   - "first": the first holder.

   If nobody could be elected, a "None" entry is written.
6. **Cleanup.** All votes for the role are deleted afterwards [6].

### Losing a role
- **Banishment.** When a citizen is banished or executed, roles flagged as not allowed for shunned citizens are removed. Their escorts are also cancelled [7].
- **Losing the shaman role** removes the status `tg_shaman_immune` and sets the citizen's MP (mystical energy points) to 0 [7].

## Role powers

### Shaman (role)
- **Points and immunity.** The new shaman gets `tg_shaman_immune` and a full MP pool. Max MP is 5 for the shaman role and 0 for everyone else [7]. MP is refilled to the maximum every night [12].
- **Heal a citizen in town** (2 MP) [8]:
  - **The healer must not** have any of these statuses: drugged, drunk, infected or terror. The healer also needs at least 2 MP.
  - **The target must** be in town, not be yourself, have terror, infection, drunk or drugged, and not already have `tg_shaman_heal` (one mystical heal per target, shown as "already had a mystical healing today").
  - **Result:** one random healable status is chosen and removed with a **65%** chance. Healing an infection also removes `tg_meta_winfect` and `tg_meta_ginfect`.
  - **Side effect:** after a successful heal there is a **5%** chance that the healer catches the status. An infection is passed on as `tg_meta_ginfect`. A healer with `tg_infect_wtns` has a 50% chance to escape an infection transfer, and loses that status in the process.
  - **Cost:** the 2 MP are spent even if the heal fails.
- **Rain dance** (3 MP, in the World Beyond) [13]:
  - It can be tried once per zone per day.
  - Success chance is **75%**.
  - Outside the town zone, it kills min(rand(3,6), zombies in the zone).
  - On the town zone, it adds **+5 water** to the well.
  - The MP is spent even if the dance fails.
- **Souls** [14]:
  - A shaman can carry several souls. Other citizens are limited to one soul (blue, red or yellow) in their rucksack.
  - Picking up a red soul outside town kills any citizen without `tg_shaman_immune` (cause: Haunted).
- The help page also says the Shaman guides citizens to the souls and brews potions that protect against tortured souls [15].

### Guide to the World Beyond
- **Zone control.** The guide gains extra zone control points equal to the number of citizens in their zone [7]. Normal base control is 2 points. A citizen with terror has 0 control points, guide or not.
- **Escorts.** The guide can lead escorts even without a hero job. The leader must not be banished and must have learning mode turned off (expert mode) to take escorts. Escorts must be enabled in the town (`OptFeatureEscort`), and the size limit is `OptFeatureEscortSize` (default 4) [13] [16].
- **Scout markings.** The guide sees the global scout markings on the map and on the beyond page [17] [18].

### Catapult master
- **Who can fire.** Only the holder of the `cata` role can fire, and only when the Catapult is complete [19].
- **What can be fired.** The item must be in your rucksack, must not be essential or broken, and must have a catapult action.
- **Cost.** 4 AP, or **2 AP** with the Upgraded Catapult (`item_courroie_#01`). You cannot fire while tired.
- **Pets** need the Small Trebuchet (`small_catapult3_#00`).
- **Deviation.** There is a **25%** chance (**5%** upgraded) that the item lands on a random orthogonally adjacent zone instead of the target.
- **Kills and log.** Zombies killed by the impact are reported to you and written in the town log.
- **Catapult page.** It shows the current living catapult master [20].

## What changes it
| Factor | Effect |
|---|---|
| Observation platform / Soul Purifying Source / Catapult (complete) | Enable the elections for guide, shaman and cata [4] |
| Upgraded Catapult | Firing costs 2 AP instead of 4; deviation drops from 25% to 5% [19] |
| Small Trebuchet | Allows firing pets [19] |
| Chaos | No votes, no counting [5] [6] |
| Banishment | Removes roles flagged as not allowed for shunned citizens; such citizens cannot be candidates [7] |
| Shaman *job* (hero job, different from the role) | Heals for 2 AP, rain dance for 1 AP plus a blue soul, can carry several souls [8] [13] |
| `DisabledRoles` setting | No election for the listed roles [5] |
| Status `tg_infect_wtns` | 50% chance to avoid catching an infection while healing [8] |

## Town types
| Type | Difference |
|---|---|
| Default | `disabled_roles: []`, so all three roles can be elected. The shaman *job* is disabled (`disabled_jobs: ["shaman"]`) and `features.shaman` is "normal" [21] [22] [23] |
| Small | `disabled_roles: ["shaman"]` and `features.shaman: "none"`: no shaman election [24] |
| Remote | No role-related differences (only the soul generation coefficient is 1.25) [25] |
| Panda | Its diff document contains no role setting, so default behaviour applies [26] |
| Custom | `DisabledRoles` and `features.shaman` can be configured [5] |

## Related
- **Shaman mode `job`/`both`.** Picking up a blue soul for the first time gives the picto `r_collec2_#00`. In "normal"/"both" mode, blue souls turn red over the nights [14] [6].
- **Spiritual guide.** `tg_spirit_guide` is a different, soul-point-based status. It is not an election [27].
- **Gazette.** An election article is written when a role holder dies outside the attack [28].
- **Other topics:** escorts, zone control, banishment and the ghoul role (a non-elected role).

## Not verified
- **Which roles are flagged "not allowed for shunned citizens".** The data fixture was not found.
- **Possible quirk 1: dead voters may still count.** The tally counts every stored vote for a candidate, so votes cast by citizens who died before the night may still count. Votes are only cascade-deleted when a citizen record is removed [29].
- **Possible quirk 2: the day-2 restriction may not apply when nobody voted.** In that fallback, the candidate list does not exclude citizens already elected that night.
- **The town-page vote API** does not itself check for an existing vote by the same author for the role. Whether the interface prevents double voting there was not checked.
- **Exact town day during `stage3_roles`.** Whether the day has already advanced, and so the exact re-election day, was not confirmed.
- **Shaman soul guidance and potions** were not checked in code. They are taken from the help page only.
